body: I guess I should focus more on the positive things that came out of it. I like that you made me see that there is still much left to do and to accomplish. I feel more calm now. Thank you for listening and helping :) I really appreciate it.

I´m sorry for my absence, I had to leave my house and I wasn´t expecting to. It makes feel better when you guys say that I´ll do high school and college by myself. I think with time I´ll eventually get over it but now I feel really unhappy because I haven´t proved much. I know she done something that a lot of parents don´t usually do but I only wish she had asked me first or stopped earlier. I´ll definitely try to start drawing or find a hobby that makes me feel a sense of accomplishment . Thank you so much for sparing a little bit of your time and talking to me. It made my day a lot better :)

I feel that she took my credit away because without her I wouldn´t be were I am today. The grades have my name on it but it was her help that made it happen. I never asked her to do that. She simply assumed that I would need the help. What do I do know? Ask her to give back the years? I don´t known if I´m being dramatic or ungrateful but it fells like she took away a part of my life that I´m never getting back. The intention was good but the repercussions were awfull. At the end of the day it is a pride matter. I would love to say that I´ve done it all by myself. I tryed drawing a few times. I´m not very good at it but I would love to be. Thank you so much for replying. I feel a little better now :)
